doc.title: Cal Collins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 11, 1997

title: Opinions on Chuck Berry and Jimi Hendrix
summary: He liked some of Chuck Berry but preferred old Texas blues players to Hendrix.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Listening to classical music, then and now

blocks.x: Okay, how about, let’s see — Chuck Berry?

Well I’ll tell you there’s some things he did that I liked. I never was a fan — I was more of a fan of his then oh the other guy that everybody went crazy about, the guitar player that played with his teeth and everything?

Yeah, Jimi Hendrix. I never was a fan of his too much at all. I liked more of the blues, the old Texas blues guys that play. There was more excitement. And it seemed like they played more of the guitar.
